Nishizono: "However, after he and his son, Tameie, died, and the Nanboku-cho Period began, well-established norms dominated the whole of the tanka community."
Nishizono: "After that, tanka was losing ground among the aristocracy for a long time, but, in the meantime, the conventional styles stayed alive without any novel ones being established."
Nishizono: "The Meiji Restoration changed that situation."
